.agents/skills/ccsn-find-simplifications.description: Use when working in the cc-safety-net repo to find non-obvious simplification candidates: dead, duplicated, speculative, over-built, or contract-exceeding surfaces in the shell parser, analyzer, guards, secret protection, policy, rules manager, audit log, hosts, CLI, or GUI. Produces evidence-backed proposals for the maintainer, not a pile of guesses.

.agents/skills/ccsn-no-comments.description: Use in the cc-safety-net repo when `bun run lint:comments` or `bun run check` reports a comment, a stale comment-allowlist entry, or a file it cannot parse, and before writing a code comment there. Moves what each comment says into code, a test, or the PR description instead of deleting it and losing it.

.agents/skills/verify-ccsn.description: Launch and drive the real cc-safety-net CLI — the hook decision path, explain, status/doctor/statusline, logs, rule and policy config, and the local policy GUI — against an isolated home, capturing evidence. Use when a change needs proof in the running app, not just the test suite.

.agents/skills/verify-project-tighten-on.description: Use in the cc-safety-net repo before finishing any change to how a project policy merges with the user policy or how a merged policy turns into protections: src/core/policy/merge.ts, safety-level.ts, env.ts (levels, capabilities, sessionSafetyLevel), effective-rules.ts, the merge call and normalizePolicyConfig in store.ts, resolveSecretDisabledRules, rule metadata flags (catastrophic, activationCapability, secret defaultOff), or a new field in GuiPolicy / ProjectPolicyProjection. .claude/skills/release-notes.description: Generate and publish concise, evidence-based notes in the body of the latest existing GitHub Release. Use only when the user explicitly invokes `$release-notes` or explicitly asks to update the latest existing GitHub Release body. Do not invoke for general release planning, changelog, tag, or version tasks.

skills/cc-safety-net.description: Operate CC Safety Net: explain why a command was blocked, triage false positives, configure custom rulebooks, manage agent CLI integrations, and diagnose protection.
